digest.component_or_area: BindingStore and related binding persistence layer
propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and peer-state delegation, violating single-responsibility and hindering safety rule enforcement.
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, creating safety and corruption risks that require extraction of a mutable-seam owner.
Retirement must enforce a durable-tombstone intent: forward/reverse pairs are removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree, and only explicit unretire revokes that intent.
Interrupted-retirement completion must run after staleness validation but before remote issue fetch and binding walk, and must read only local state without interleaving new liveness evidence.

Extract three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) behind one unchanged BindingStore facade to preserve existing imports, serialization, unknown fields, and all_bindings() shallow compatibility.
